name: fp-cookbook
description: Practical cookbook of forgeplan CLI recipes — task-oriented guides covering onboarding, PRD authoring, evidence patterns, workflow cycles, multi-plugin discipline, AI-pair dispatch, troubleshooting and a CLI/MCP quick reference, each shaped as goal -> command -> example -> common errors. Use when you know what you want from forgeplan and need the exact invocation, not the methodology behind it. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
